connector.name: JVM Source Lens
connector.registryDescription: Gradle-accurate JVM classpath; fetch Java source, signatures, and class structure for agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package jvmsrc. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sintexer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.description: Optional absolute path for resolution and decompile caches (default: OS cache dir).

env.name: JVMSRC_LOG_DIR
env.description: Optional absolute path for failure diagnostic logs.

env.name: JVMSRC_MAX_SOURCE_OUTPUT_CHARS
env.description: Max characters returned for full-file source (default 524288).

env.name: JVMSRC_GRADLE_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Gradle resolution subprocess timeout in milliseconds.

env.name: JVMSRC_CFR_PATH
env.description: Optional path to a custom CFR JAR for decompilation.
